We’re excited to announce that our [b]Steam page is now complete![/b] We know that you all are waiting for the Demo - at the moment, our team is hard at work perfecting it and we believe that you’ll truly enjoy the final outcome. Stay tuned—details about the demo release will be coming your way soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3219820/Road_Motel_Simulator/
